articles.title: Crypto's powerhouse super PAC suffers costly setback as Democrats sweep Congress
articles.snippet: The industry's primary campaign arm had cultivated a reputation as an unstoppable force, but more than a third of its spending failed to hit the mark, especially in Ohio.

articles.title: U.S. Democratic sweep could be the final nail in the ‘Clarity Act’s coffin’
articles.snippet: Industry experts warn the Clarity Act is likely dead in its current form as incoming Democratic majorities eye tighter scrutiny of crypto markets and tokenized stocks.

articles.title: Zcash grants committee drops plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC to future mining rewards
articles.snippet: The committee withdrew its proposal after community backlash, leaving competing plans to cut off its funding or preserve the existing grants system.

articles.title: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange’s founder warned of security staffing shortages amid restructuring as analysts flagged suspicious transfers potentially linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack.

articles.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
articles.snippet: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday, even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.
